purpose: Defines the test principles, the requirement-to-design-to-acceptance verification mapping, and the cross-cutting scenarios used to verify the doc-link design.
summary: Test norms for stateful processing: the DES-004 transition table is the only allowed transition list, with guard-failure, unlisted-event and wrong-state events rejected
Missing referenced targets do not block candidate confirmation; interruption, rerun, old confirmed ToC retention and multi-key isolation are covered by state tests
Test cases for check-impact: read-only behavior, comparing recorded content hashes with current hashes, repeated reporting until the record is rewritten, no notification chaining or loops
Test cases for check-links: DLID-bearing inline links, record-word form in titles, path mismatch after moves within targets, duplicates and absence, no use of managed-state records

Test cases for inspection and pre-search checks: stdout limited to counts, full details in a detail file, constant stdout size, zero-finding runs, write failure as error, nothing written except the detail file
List of deterministic non-stateful processing that gets separate unit tests, such as target expansion, Markdown parsing, ID handling, DLID resolution and detail file writing
Mapping table from requirements (FR, NFR) to main design documents and main verification points with acceptance criteria
Seven cross-cutting scenarios: first build, move, content change, failure, multiple keys, out-of-scope references, and later-added section references
